historical_record.description: The Spring Valley Grammar School, a fourteen-classroom fireproof school, of reinforced concrete to the second floor, faced in pressed brick and terra cotta, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by Caldwell & Co. on a $64,391 general contract.
